description: Get one SportPoint place (gym, pool, hall, venue) by slug (from search_clubs_and_places): address, description, and one Monday-to-Sunday week of the sessions held there with price in EUR and spots left. Pass week as any date (YYYY-MM-DD) in the wanted week; the default is the current week.

slug.description: The place slug, as returned by search_clubs_and_places.

week.description: Any date (YYYY-MM-DD) in the week to show. Defaults to the current week.

name: get_place
title: Get Place
